harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1's (OPNsense) previously unconfigured vtnet2 interface as a new zone "LAN-B" (opt1) with static IP 10.20.20.1/24, matching node3's dedicated eth1 NIC (set to 10.20.20.2/24). Also configured the parallel lan-a interface vtnet1 as "LAN-A" (opt1... opt2) with 10.10.10.1/24, matched to node2's dedicated eth1 (10.10.10.2/24), since node1 acting as router between lan-a and lan-b was required for node3 to reach node2 through node1. Added OPNsense firewall pass rules for both new zones (preserving the existing anti-lockout/SSH rule on the management lan/vtnet0), and added persistent NetworkManager routes on node2/node3 so lan-b<->lan-a traffic transits node1 rather than the shared management network. Verified via ping/tracepath/pf state that node3 reaches node1 directly on lan-b (1 hop) and reaches node2 on lan-a through node1 (2 hops, pf state entries confirm forwarding). Completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot markers and health on all 3 nodes, restarted each node one at a time (node1 via configctl system reboot, node2/node3 via systemctl reboot), confirmed each node's boot identity changed (FreeBSD kern.boottime advanced ~9.5 min on node1; Linux boot_id changed on node2 and node3), and re-verified post-restart that interface addresses, firewall zones, and end-to-end lan-a/lan-b connectivity through node1 all recovered correctly.
actions_performed: Inspected node1/node2/node3 network state and OPNsense config.xml to map physical NICs to the lan-a/lan-b topology
Used temporary IPs + ping tests to empirically confirm vtnet1<->node2 eth1 (lan-a) and vtnet2<->node3 eth1 (lan-b) L2 adjacency
Edited node1's /conf/config.xml via Python script to add opt1 (LAN-A, 10.10.10.1/24) and opt2 (LAN-B, 10.20.20.1/24) interfaces with firewall pass rules, backing up the original config
Applied via configctl interface reconfigure opt1/opt2 and configctl filter reload, verified pf ruleset preserved the vtnet0 SSH anti-lockout rule

Configured node2 eth1 (10.10.10.2/24) and node3 eth1 (10.20.20.2/24) persistently via nmcli, plus static routes for the opposite lan subnet via node1's IP on the local zone (lower metric than the default route to avoid disrupting exec transport)
Verified end-to-end connectivity: node3<->node1 direct on lan-b, node3<->node2 routed through node1 on lan-a, confirmed with ping, tracepath, and pfctl state table
Captured pre-restart boot-identity and health baselines on all 3 nodes
Rebooted node1 (configctl system reboot), polled until exec available, confirmed new kern.boottime and full recovery of interfaces/connectivity
Rebooted node2 (systemctl reboot), polled until exec available, confirmed new boot_id and full recovery of eth1 config/routes/connectivity
Rebooted node3 (systemctl reboot), polled until exec available, confirmed new boot_id and full recovery of eth1 config/routes/connectivity

evidence.requirement: node1's lan-b-facing interface identified and brought into service as its own zone with an address
evidence.summary: vtnet2 identified as facing node3 (lan-b) via temp-IP ping test, then configured in config.xml as opt2/LAN-B with 10.20.20.1/24 and a firewall pass rule, applied and verified in ifconfig/pf ruleset

evidence.requirement: node3 reaches node1 directly on lan-b
evidence.summary: ping from node3 to node1's lan-b address 10.20.20.1 succeeds with ttl=64 (1 hop), both before and after node restarts

evidence.requirement: node3 reaches node2 on lan-a through node1
evidence.summary: ping/tracepath from node3 to node2's lan-a address 10.10.10.2 succeeds with ttl=63 (2 hops via 10.20.20.1), and node1's pf state table shows the forwarded icmp flow between 10.20.20.2 and 10.10.10.2

evidence.requirement: existing SSH/exec access to node1 not broken by new firewall rules
evidence.summary: pfctl -s rules output after filter reload still shows the pass-in rule for tcp/ssh on vtnet0, confirming the management/anti-lockout path was preserved

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline kern.boottime captured (16:24:14), reboot acknowledged then connection dropped, post-reboot exec shows new kern.boottime (16:33:04), and interfaces/zones/connectivity to node2 and node3 verified recovered

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8c28f3cd... captured, reboot issued, post-reboot boot_id changed to e3d4cb5f..., eth1 static IP/route and ping to node1 lan-a verified recovered

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e65e6bcf... captured, reboot issued, post-reboot boot_id changed to c657b527..., eth1 static IP/route and full end-to-end connectivity to node1 (lan-b) and node2 (lan-a through node1) verified recovered
